scope: Reviewed issue and milestone subset, not complete six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Capabilities use different triage, write, owner/admin and account/enterprise constraints.
rows.requirement: Bind exact operation, target ownership, platform/version and effective permission; unavailable/missing authority stays unknown or denied.
rows.negative_test: Triage must not authorize organization field management or deletion; EMU external target must not pass.

rows.conflict: Hierarchy, prerequisite direction and blocked icons are distinct; transitivity/cycle and closure enforcement unspecified.
rows.requirement: Model parent/child and blocking edges separately; verify direction and supported graph constraints before enforced workflow adoption.
rows.negative_test: Parent association or blocked icon cannot certify prevention of closure/merge.

rows.conflict: Closed/not-planned, auto-close and hierarchy/milestone percentages are lifecycle, not verified acceptance.
rows.requirement: Keep immutable requirement denominator and current criterion-level evidence separate from issue state, duplicates and display percentages.
rows.negative_test: Not-planned closure/default-branch merge without acceptance evidence must not improve verified completion.

rows.conflict: Description/commit and sidebar origins have different default-branch/repository/unlink semantics.
rows.requirement: Resolve exact repository/issue/branch/reference origin; preview auto-close effects and preserve human-only closure where policy requires.
rows.negative_test: Remembered repository or commit auto-close lacking listed PR link cannot pass target/link verification.

rows.conflict: Issue fields are shared truth; custom Project fields local; template assignments unavailable and migration omits copy procedure.
rows.requirement: Explicitly map old/new field identities and values, copy/verify with authority before view removal; distinguish definition/default/pinning from assignment.
rows.negative_test: Same Priority label or removed Project column cannot certify copied issue values.

rows.conflict: Organization-only restricts surfaces; internal Projects accept only Public fields; Public does not grant private issue access.
rows.requirement: Verify effective visibility across repository/project/API/timeline/search with authorized member/collaborator/outsider probes.
rows.negative_test: Public field setting cannot authorize private issue disclosure; hiding column alone cannot prove access restriction.

rows.conflict: Permanent definition/value deletion, reversible type disable and issue survival after milestone deletion have different custody implications.
rows.requirement: Classify destructive versus reversible changes; preserve export/identity/dependencies and verify authorized restore or declared irreversible consequences.
rows.negative_test: Recreate field or surviving issue must not certify restored values/associations.

rows.conflict: Clone new identity/no mention notifications differs transfer redirect/notifications and constrained ownership/disclosure.
rows.requirement: Check both authorities and allowed visibility, map metadata by exact documented identity, read back retained state and audiences.
rows.negative_test: Same milestone name with different due date or private-to-public transfer cannot pass; clone cannot claim comments retained.

rows.conflict: Platform numerical limits and enabled default fields are not local workload policy or initialized values.
rows.requirement: Pin feature/version and separate capacity limits/default field definitions from adopted workload thresholds; retain unavailable operations.
rows.negative_test: Hundred-child limit or default Priority field cannot silently become desired task count/assigned priority.

rows.conflict: Duplicate timeline marker/Undo records relationships, not semantic equivalence or acceptance.
rows.requirement: Require independent scope-equivalence rationale and preserve original identities/history before treating work as duplicate.
rows.negative_test: Duplicate comment or Undo cannot certify resolved claims, deleted history or accepted issue.

rows.conflict: Filters, checkbox selection and reset are display/selection operations, not full denominator acquisition.
rows.requirement: Declare exact search context, pagination, inaccessible scope and selected mutation target set; verify readback without shrinking required denominator.
rows.negative_test: Filtered result or cleared search cannot certify all estate items reviewed or state changed.

limitations: Requirements and negative tests are proposals, not execution receipts.
Claim identity verification does not establish independent equivalence or omission completeness.
No native changes, rights clearance or policy acceptance.
